title: Market Square and Maquette
content: "Market Square" and the archway maquette I built for lighting reference are both now on view at "The Art of James Gurney" exhibit at the University of the Arts in Philadelphia through November 16.-----My Public FacebookpageGurneyJourney onPinterestJamesGurney Art onInstagram@GurneyJourney on TwitterMore on maquettes in my bookImaginative Realism: How to Paint What Doesn't Exist
